propositions: Expected and auto-handled best-effort tickets-branch push failures surface at WARNING level with wording that primes LLM agents to assume the store is broken and investigate non-issues
Mid-retry transient transport retry notices and routine unpushed-backlog messages are surfaced at INFO or WARNING despite being self-healing under normal concurrent-writer load
The unpushed_summary message references bare `..HEAD` which sessions misinterpret as their code worktree HEAD rather than the tracker HEAD, escalating concern across concurrent sessions

Lost-contention race outcomes and transient transport faults must be demoted to DEBUG for normal load while preserving WARNING for operator-actionable signals: policy declines, strict failures, and proven-growing backlogs

Expected-case push logging must state the self-healing contract and suppress messages from agent-visible output (INFO and above) without affecting durable marker observability or fsck PUSH_PENDING channels
